traits: A three-wheeled jogging stroller, scanned. No legs: it learned to drive its two rear wheels and steer the front one. Cannot strafe or spin on the spot; tips over if it turns too hard.
_terrains_note: Flat tracks only: it was trained on flat ground (banks and hurdles are untested; a 6 cm hurdle is a third of its front wheel).
_impratio_note: At impratio 100 the stiff friction under the race's 1-iteration solver binds the three wheels and steering does nothing (training/stroller/make_model.py); it trains and races at 1, as Matt does.
_footGeoms_note: Its wheels: the contact audit holds them to the tighter foot limit.
_brain_note: stroller_roll = run s1 (train.py --env stroller, 14.7 M steps, 16 min on the RTX 5070 Ti, 2026-11-10). Ladder on MuJoCo 4.0.0 CPU: every test 10/10, graduation 100/100 (mean err 0.074, 0 tipped). Weights final/stroller_s1_params.pkl.
_width_note: Body width across the track (m), arms at the sides: the tactics keep (width + other's) / 2 + 0.2 m beside another racer when passing or blocking (never less than Unity's 0.65).
_pace_note: Planar Sprint alone, seed 1: 100 m in 70.92 s at a 1.45 m/s command (Slice 5 method).
